card.name: Economic and farm production nouns before output
card.fires_on: Words in economics and agriculture text that come right before a production or output term, such as corn, economic, manufacturing, meat or egg. Also on small linking words like in and between in sentences about yields and supply.

modes.label: Crop or livestock word
modes.description: A farm product word that is followed by production or output.
modes.example: only about 10 percent of U.S.<< corn>> production is processed directly into food products.

modes.label: Economic growth word
modes.description: The word economic or an industry name before activity, growth or output.
modes.example: These recent trends reflect the accelerating shift of<< economic>> growth from developed metro areas in the global

modes.label: Linking word in yield talk
modes.description: A small word like in or between in sentences about falling yields or supply balance.
modes.example: It was the second consecutive year of a drop<< in>> average yields around the world.

card.writes: It makes the word output (and production-type words) more likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on farm or economy words when the next word is likely to be output or production.
